notes.title: Mac version update!
notes.notes:
We've released a new build that should resolve the crashing users were seeing before! We tested it on a Mojave operating system and found that it worked great, so hopefully users who were having those issues will see an improvement as well! 

We did notice that Mojave has a number of new security features that interfered with the game a lot--running it through Steam circumnavigates a lot of the issues, but we wonder if that could be a cause for some users' experience. If you're still having issues, trying going into System Preferences > Accessibility > Privacy and add Wandersong to the list of apps which can "control your computer." This security feature is triggered by the fact that the game resets the mouse position when you're singing to keep your cursor in the game window (just like a first person shooter might).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30580272/5de74b74b19e70b55fb8ceab4cf10863bdf5b284.png

Hopefully this helps! Thank you everyone for your support :)

notes.title: Mac Players, An Update on Current Issues!
notes.notes:
Hello Mac players!

We're aware right now of two uncommon issues some players are facing. It sounds like some users on the Mojave OS are seeing a black screen, and for some players, the game crashes in the Act 4 factory. We're sorry about this!

For the crash issue, there's a quick way to remedy it. Right click the game in your Steam library > Properties > BETAs tab > select "old-reliable" from the dropdown! This older version has some visual issues but no crashing. Once you're in Act 5, you can return to the original branch.

We've been aware of these issues for a time, but our own Mac we were using to test didn't have these issues. As of this year, thanks to the modest success of Wandersong, I decided to get a new Mac computer (the old one was a Macbook from 2009). I'm working on setting up the new machine and will hopefully be able to test and update the game soon to fix these issues for everyone. Some of it might be an engine-level issue with Game Maker, though, which means it could take some extra time to figure out since that would be out of my hands. 

Mac users represent around 0.2% of all Wandersong players, but we really want you to have a good experience and I'm sorry for the issues that some of you have experienced. We'll post if and when we have an update!

notes.title: Speedrun & Stability Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

First of all, I want to congratulate our dedicated Wandersong speedrunners, who recently discovered some hidden features we had and the alternate "bad" ending. Well done!! We were worried they would be secret forever.

Following that discovery, we've made one new additional skip available today to bring the speedrun time even lower. Nice!

Additionally, this new build contains new features to help stabilize the game at different framerates + monitor refresh rates, which is our most common complaint. Users across the board should see a much more stable experience. Double nice!!

Finally, this new build also has expanded capability for language translation modding. Triple nice!!! With this, players helping with our ongoing fan translation project will be able to test their modded text more easily in-game, and eventually distribute their translations. Woo! Details on how to implement translations will be aded to the spreadsheet soon.

Thanks again to everyone for your continued love and support!
Greg

notes.title: Patch 4...
notes.notes:
Heh??? We made the tragic mistake of changing physics in our last patch, and boy howdy did that cause some problems! Thankfully you've all been gracious and patient with us as we cleared up the new problems as well as some old ones. Here's newly fixed stuff:
Act 1: Bard leaps lower out of bed on low framerates
Act 3: Able to jump over certain room exit
Act 5: Launch distance from bubbles reduced on low framerates
Act 5: Infinite hug
Act 6: Birds don't launch very far
Act 6: Birds STILL don't always respawn
Act 6: Partner character's pathing not great on low framerates
Act 6: Some platforming near the end is a bit high for the bard's jump height on some framerates
Act 7: Reloading the big confrontation would have some heads swapped
Post-game: Scene select animated to frames and not deltatime

Some Mac users are still seeing memory-related crashes, which we think is an engine issue, and we're talking to Yoyogames about this. Other than that, we're actually quite close to fixing all known issues on PC, which is a big deal! (Can't wait to inadvertently summon many more with this claim, LOL). 

If your progress is blocked we highly recommend you use the code on our support page to skip through! Thank you again for your patience and understanding as I work through this stuff ASAP :)

notes.title: Patch 3?!
notes.notes:
That was fast! I put a bunch of time in and fixed more stuff. Check out these addressed issues! As always, if you are experiencing issues be sure to check out our support page.
General: Consistent jump height and more stable physics at different framerates! This should help clear a lot of the generally "buggy" issues players have commented on. If the game feels choppy, I still highly recommend lowering resolution and/or playing windowed--the game feels really great when playing at full speed!
General: A previously unobtainable achievement is now obtainable
Act 4: able to progress story without officially recruiting characters
Act 5: optional leaf on map appears to be required to progress story
Act 6: birds don't always respawn
Act 6: wind changing directions a bit futzy in one segment
Act 6: softlock with Audrey during bug sequence
Act 6: A set of jumps are very high and a bit difficult
Post-game: Gabe can't be interacted with

Notably, the issues are starting to lean later and later into the game... that's thanks to more players playing farther in, but it also means the more commonly played areas (act 1-3) are looking close to bug free! =) Hopefully after this patch there are very few bugs left.

Let us know how it goes!

notes.title: Patch 1!
notes.notes:
We updated the game with our first patch! Here are the issues addressed:

Get stuck when going to band break room after Act 2 concert
Soft lock when loading first screen of Act 5 castle 
Game goes to 144 FPS on startup in fullscreen on some monitors, causing the bard's jump height to cut in half (please let us know if this is still an issue...! We have V-sync OFF by default now, and put an option to turn it ON in options. V-Sync in GameMaker seems to interact badly with some monitors, but we don't have this issue on our machines so it's hard for us to explore).
Rare error message and crash during Act 2 performance
"Pause" button does't work as confirmation to exit
Catterfly can follow you past where her battle ends
Keyboard singing input doesn't accept the same note consecutively
Crash when talking to Captain Lucas from the left in the pirate bar 
3-ghost boss can scale strangely after battle is over


There are still some things we know about and want to fix, but this is th worst stuff we think. Fingers crossed that it goes smoothly, we'll be watching!
